beats.delivery: Professional, concise, and paced for an introductory course audience.
beats.narration: An interdisciplinary plan should not begin by collecting unrelated courses that sound interesting. Begin with an outcome. What problem do you want to address, for whom, and what would a successful result look like? A concrete outcome provides a reason for bringing multiple fields together.
beats.title: Begin with an outcome, not a course list
beats.visualDirection: template:showcase-interdisciplinary | Turn a broad interest into a concrete problem, audience, and desired outcome.

beats.delivery: Professional, concise, and paced for an introductory course audience.
beats.narration: Next, assign each discipline a job. One field might provide technical methods, another might explain human context, and a third might support design or evaluation. The connection must be explicit. If removing a field would not change the question or method, its role in the plan may not yet be clear.
beats.title: Assign each discipline a job
beats.visualDirection: template:showcase-interdisciplinary | Map one field to technical capability, another to human context, and a shared project to integration.

beats.delivery: Professional, concise, and paced for an introductory course audience.
beats.narration: Finally, sequence the learning. Identify foundations, methods, advanced work, and a project that forces the fields to interact. RIT individualized study pairs this planning with academic advising and connections to faculty and experiential learning. The goal is not maximum variety. It is an intentional path that produces evidence you can address the question.
beats.title: Build an advised path to evidence
beats.visualDirection: template:showcase-interdisciplinary | Sequence foundational courses, methods, an integrating project, and experiential learning with advisor review.

claims.text: Individualized study is organized around a student's interests, skills, and professional goals.
Students can blend coursework from multiple areas to build a customized set of knowledge and skills.
RIT individualized-study students work with advisors to select courses and connect coursework with faculty and experiential learning.

sources.author: RIT School of Individualized Study
sources.excerpt: RIT individualized study allows students whose interests do not fit neatly within a traditional degree to blend coursework around personal, professional, and career goals. Students work with academic advisors to identify interests and goals, select courses that build needed skills, connect with faculty, and map experiences such as co-op, internships, research, and study abroad. The result is an intentional plan of study rather than an unrelated collection of courses.
